notes: Modified cash basis school district (FY ends 2025-08-31), governmental funds only, no business-type funds. Basic statements use the Total Governmental Funds column on Exhibit D (p5), which is net of the reclassification column (transfers eliminated: 85,630 General to Other Governmental and 4,047,060.03 among General Fund components). Cash basis: beginning/ending_cash are the fund balances the statement rolls forward (cash in bank plus cash at county treasurer); fund balances left null. Reconciles: 15,680,434.25 + 37,870,803.75 - 27,651,764.12 = 25,899,473.88; the printed receipts total includes Issuance of bonds 9,958,161.50 (9,500,000 bonds + 458,161.50 premium, p16), recorded in debt_proceeds, so receipts items sum to 27,912,642.25. 'Taxes: Other' 4,947,737.25 split into state aid (homestead, property tax credit, pro-rate motor vehicle) and other taxes (carline, nameplate, railroad) using Exhibit G, L, M, N (ties exactly). 'County receipts' split using code 2110 county fines 126,932.60 (fines and forfeitures) and 2210 ESU receipts 7,216.33. 'Non-revenue receipts' 228,697.08 split into insurance adjustments 20,062.46, sale of property 8,705 (p9), Depreciation Fund other 30,660 (p11) and Employee Benefit Fund other 169,269.62 (p12). 'Other support services' 1,798,591.80 split into School Nutrition 886,420.69 (food service) and Activities 912,171.11 (student activities), which sum exactly. 'Debt service' split into principal and interest/fees from Exhibits L, M, N. 'Other local receipts' 1,442,216.18 not split (activities receipts are about 65% of it); recorded as charges for services/fees with review. Detail: Exhibit F (General Fund components) not recorded to avoid double counting; Exhibit G/H/I schedules cover those funds.
